upstreamDescriptor.source: pinned OpenClaw 2026.9.1 gateway protocol/core descriptor evidence

openClaw: dispatch, move, reclaim, and cloud worker lifecycle

node.list.productIntegration: bounded diagnostic inventory; not a second product registry

node.rename.params: native node identifier and display name
node.rename.productIntegration: typed existing management boundary; not added as Phase 8 UX

node.invoke.params: native node command and target payload
node.invoke.productIntegration: internal typed boundary only; no generic invoke UI

environments.create.productIntegration: explicit typed action only when advertised and authorized

environments.destroy.productIntegration: explicit typed destructive action; Gateway local is rejected

sessions.dispatch.params: { key, agentId?, deviceId?, autoDevice?, profileId?, machineClass? }
sessions.dispatch.productIntegration: typed automatic, device, or configured profile destination

sessions.move.params: { key, agentId?, expected: { generation, environmentId, ownerEpoch }, target }
sessions.move.productIntegration: selected-session move action with native expectations

environmentProjection.gatewayLocal: native environment id gateway, type local, sessionHost preserved
environmentProjection.nodeEnvironments: native node/environment records remain distinct from diagnostic node reads
environmentProjection.workerEnvironments: native worker profile, lifecycle, slots, trust, and attachment facts preserved
environmentProjection.readFailure: unknown/unavailable projection, never an authoritative empty inventory
environmentProjection.partialDetailFailure: valid inventory retained; selected detail becomes unknown
environmentProjection.nativeStrings: labels, issues, capabilities, and host diagnostics treated as data

environmentStatusAndEligibility.eligibleDestination: sessionHost=true and normalized status=available; worker environments also require ready, attached, or idle native worker state
environmentStatusAndEligibility.capacity: native workerSlots only; no AgentOS placement calculation

nodeProjection.issues: native issue facts preserved without speculative reinterpretation

placement.fallbackLocationHint: execNode is retained only as an unknown location hint when rich placement is absent
placement.currentPlacement: native state, generation, environmentId, profileId, deviceId, and activeOwnerEpoch
placement.automatic: native sessions.dispatch with autoDevice=true; OpenClaw chooses placement

mutationTruthfulness.definiteRejection: failed; no reconciliation success and no retry
mutationTruthfulness.ambiguousOutcome: one mutation call, at most one authoritative reread, transition proof required
mutationTruthfulness.preExistingTargetState: matching pre-state plus ambiguous delivery is unknown unless native response gives stronger exact proof
mutationTruthfulness.createIdentity: server-generated native idempotency key, passed once to native create
mutationTruthfulness.destroySafety: explicit confirmation, live target validation, no Gateway/local destroy target

productAuthorization.placementMutation: sessions.place, owner-only in shared-service policy, plus native dynamic preflight
productAuthorization.environmentLifecycle: existing lifecycle.manage owner-level policy plus native operator.admin preflight
productAuthorization.browserTargetValidation: server validates live native topology/profile inventory

eventsAndRefresh.topologyInvalidation: relevant native node/session events invalidate bounded topology/detail projections
eventsAndRefresh.selectedPlacementRefresh: existing live refresh generation is reused by selected-session inspector
eventsAndRefresh.staleResponseFencing: AbortController and selection-bound requests prevent old environment/session detail from overwriting a new selection

performance.selectedEnvironmentDetail: at most one environments.status or node.describe for the selected detail
